print.title: Print
print.tight: Some crop marks don't fit: cut line added for {{names}}
print.insideIgnored: The inside won't print, double-sided is off: {{names}}
print.tip: Print at 100% ("Actual size"), never "Fit to page". The ruler must measure 100 mm.
print.slowWarning: Above 600 DPI the export is slow and the file heavy, with no visible gain on home printers.
print.general1: Print at 100% ("Actual size"), never "Fit to page".
print.general2: Check the ruler: it must measure exactly 100 mm.
print.general3: Let the ink dry for at least 10 minutes before cutting or folding.
print.general4: You need: craft knife, metal ruler, cutting mat, an empty ballpoint for scoring, glue stick or double-sided tape.
print.calibrationHint: Print it once on the paper you will use: it gives you the X/Y values.
print.zoomHint: Click a sheet to enlarge it
print.enhanceSmall: Better enlargement for small images (slower export)
print.join1: Cut out the parts ({parts}). The tabs stay attached and carry a letter ({letters}).
print.join2: Score the fold of each tab and bend it slightly back.
print.join3: Glue the tab and lay the part with the same letter on it, its edge exactly on the fold.
print.join4: Let it dry before folding the rest.
print.splitInfo_one: {{names}}: larger than A4, printed in parts to join.
print.splitInfo_other: {{names}}: larger than A4, printed in parts to join.
print.rulerHint: A 100 mm ruler to check the print is to scale.
print.rulerMissing: No room for the ruler: lower the printer margin or turn it off.
print.instructionsHint: One more sheet with the assembly steps.
print.pngHint: No quality loss: about 40 MB per sheet at 600 DPI.
print.jpegHint: Lighter file, about 8 MB per sheet, with possible small artefacts on edges and text.

asm.cutMarks: Cut along the crop marks with a ruler and craft knife.
asm.cutLine: Cut along the thin cut line.
asm.scoreFolds: Score the folds by running an empty ballpoint along a ruler, then fold.

booklet1.insert: Slide the sheet under the tabs in the case lid.

booklet4.fold: Fold in half with the print outside: page 1 must be at the front.

tray.insert: Lift out the clear tray, lay the tray card in the bottom of the case and snap the tray back in.

disc.cut: Cut the outer circle and the hole (a circle cutter helps).
disc.apply: Centre the label from the hole and smooth it outwards, without bubbles.

dvd.insert: Slide the cover under the clear film of the case, starting from the spine.

sleeve.flaps: Fold the flaps towards the unprinted side.
sleeve.glue: Put glue on the flaps, close the sleeve and press the edges well.

bookletN.nest: Fold each sheet in half and nest them in order, sheet 1 outside.
bookletN.staple: Staple twice along the fold, then trim the open edge if needed.

obi.wrap: Fold along the spine lines and slide the strip over the left side of the case.

ocard.fold: Fold every horizontal line: the back, printed upside down, ends up the right way.
ocard.glue: Glue the flap to close the band into a loop around the case.

slipcase.walls: Fold the spine and both walls to 90°.
slipcase.glue: Glue the tabs under the back. The slipcase stays open on the right.

digipak.fold: Fold along both spine lines, print outside.

bluray.insert: Slide the cover under the clear film of the Blu-ray case, starting from the spine.

six.fold: Fold the flap inwards, under the front, then close along the spine.

pocket.glue: Fold the three tabs back and glue the pocket on the inside right, open side towards the spine.

slipcover.glue: Fold the four sides square and glue the flap inside the back edge, making a tube open at both ends.
slipcover.insert: Slide the case in from the top: it should move without forcing.

holder.tray: Glue the tray centred on the inside right: adhesive or 3D printed.
holder.pocket: Glue the pocket centred on the inside right, open side towards the spine.

flap.slit: Cut the curved slit in the back with a single cut, removing no paper.
flap.close: Slide the disc in, fold the flap over the back and push the tab into the slit.
flap.tuck: Slide the disc in, fold the flap and tuck it between the back and the disc.

calib.title: Double-sided calibration
calib.step1: Print both pages double-sided, with the paper and edge (long or short) of the project.
calib.step2: Look at the sheet against the light from the back.
calib.step3: Read where the front's vertical line crosses the horizontal scale (X), and where its horizontal line crosses the vertical scale (Y).
calib.step4: Enter the values in "Back-side correction (X / Y)". If the lines cross at 0, nothing to correct.

preview.printsBoth: outside, and inside if you like (double-sided)
preview.clickToAdd: Click a piece to add it to the project.

tray.title: 3D-printed tray
tray.intro: Tray to 3D print, {{w}} × {{h}} mm, {{height}} mm high. Glue it on the inside right.
tray.fitHint: The grip you choose applies to all projects.
tray.spineTooThin: The spine is too thin for the tray and disc: it needs at least {{need}} mm.
tray.printTips: PLA or PETG, 0.2 mm layers, no supports, flat side down. Glue with strong double-sided tape, none under the arms.
tray.testHint: A 44 mm disc with the hub only: prints in a few minutes to test the grip.
tray.usage: Rest the disc on the hub and press the centre until it clicks. To remove it, lift it from a notch.
tray.fitShort: If the disc wobbles choose Tight, if it is hard to push on choose Loose.

color.pick: Pick a colour from the screen

framing.circleHint: Use zoom and position to choose what stays in the circle.

qr.title: QR code
qr.eccHint: More robust reads even when damaged, but the modules get smaller.
qr.okDenser: Readable: {{n}}×{{n}} modules of {{mod}} mm, denser for the logo
qr.problem_empty: Type an address or some text.
qr.problem_tooLong: Too long for a QR code: use a shorter link.
qr.problem_logoBig: Logo too large: phones may not read the code.
qr.problem_small: Too small: make it at least {{min}} mm or shorten the text.
qr.problem_contrast: Low contrast: use dark modules on a light background.
qr.logoHint: Transparent parts (PNG, WebP) let the code show through.
qr.logoUse: The logo uses {{pct}}% of the error reserve. Up to {{max}}% leaves room for scratches.
qr.logoEcc: With a logo, robustness stays at maximum.
qr.logoOpaqueTip: With a transparent background the logo can be larger.
qr.logoTest: Logo above {{pct}}%: test a print with your phone.
qr.testHint: Before printing many copies, test a print with your phone.

holder.pocketAdd: Add the pocket to the project ({{w}} × {{h}} mm)

ai.unused: not used in the project yet
ai.dpiNow: {{dpi}} DPI at its largest print size
ai.viewerHint: Pick a model and an enlargement, then press Start
ai.noGpu: This browser cannot use the graphics card: only Lite is available, and it is slower. For the other models use Chrome or Edge.

model.liteDesc: Fast, works without a graphics card too.
model.ultramixDesc: Natural photos, balanced sharpness and detail.

ai.deleteModelHint: Removes the model from the browser. It downloads again if needed.
ai.capDpi: Beyond {{max}} DPI print does not improve
ai.capPixels: Too big for the browser's memory
ai.capNote: No need to enlarge beyond {{max}} DPI.
ai.notNeeded: It already has {{dpi}} DPI: no need to enlarge it.
ai.tooBig: Enlarged, it would be too big for the browser's memory. It already has enough pixels.
ai.stopped: Stopped. Change the choices and start again.
ai.prepareHint: The first time this can take a few seconds.
ai.attemptsHint: Click a result to see it. Try other models: the results stay here.
ai.chooseFirst: Start to get a result to use.
ai.replaceHint: Layers using the original switch to the new picture. Ctrl+Z undoes it.
ai.replaceHintUnused: The new picture takes the original's place.
ai.addHint: The new picture is added, the original stays.
ai.replacedToast: Picture replaced with the enhanced version
ai.addedToast: Enhanced picture added to the list
ai.privacy: The picture stays on your computer. Only the model is downloaded, once.

error.offline: You are offline and the model is not downloaded yet. Connect and try again.
error.network: The model could not be downloaded. Check the connection and try again.
error.integrity: The downloaded model is not valid. Try again or reload the page.
error.storage: The browser could not save the picture. Free some space and try again.
error.gpu: Graphics card error. Try Lite or a smaller enlargement.
error.memory: Picture too big for memory. Try a smaller enlargement.

ai.applyHint: Replace: layers switch to the new picture. Add: it joins the list.
ai.applyHintUnused: Replace takes the original's place, Add keeps both.
ai.whenDone: Then you can use the result or compare it.
